title: How to use RNExchange (Exchange Operator)
subtitle: A guide to operating the exchange and running settlements in the RNExchange simulator
introduction: Welcome to RNExchange Exchange Operator! This is a simulated trading environment designed for educational purposes. All settlement processing, statements, and system operations are simulated — this is NOT real money.

responsibilities.title: Your Responsibilities as an Exchange Operator
items: Run end-of-day (EOD) settlement processing for trading days
Monitor exchange health and system status
Oversee broker and trader account reconciliation

items.name: Exchange Overview
items.description: Dashboard showing EOD batches, key metrics (accounts processed, positions processed, net P&L), and system status

items.name: Settlement Batches
items.description: List of all EOD settlement runs with dates, status, and processing metrics

items.name: System Status
items.description: Monitor exchange health, broker status, and trading system availability

items.title: Monitor Exchange Status
items.description: Go to Exchange Overview to see current system health and active trading activity

items.title: Run End-of-Day Settlement
items.description: Select a trading date and trigger EOD processing. This will revalue positions, generate MTM entries, and create daily statements

items.title: Review Settlement Batch
items.description: After EOD completes, view the settlement batch details including accounts processed, positions processed, and net P&L

items.title: Verify Statement Generation
items.description: Confirm that daily statements have been generated for traders and brokers for the processed date

items.title: Handle Reruns
items.description: EOD is idempotent — rerunning for the same date will recompute and overwrite previous statements without duplication

demoUsers.title: Demo Users
demoUsers.description: For testing and demos, use the exchange_demo account. This account has full system access and can run EOD for any trading date.

disclaimer: Remember: RNExchange is a simulated environment. All settlement processing and system operations are for educational purposes only. This is NOT real money or real trading.
